example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো একটা ধুমসা, কখনো স্নান করে না।
গ্রামের সেই ধুমসা লোকটাকে দেখে সবাই হাসে।
example_sentences_in_english: He's such a sooty slob, he never bathes.
Everyone laughs at that soot-covered guy from the village.
note: Refers to someone appearing dirty from soot, common in traditional cooking or labor contexts in Bengali rural life.
